dereference.description: Always follow symbolic links; matches --dereference flag. If false, --no-dereference is implied.

preserve_attributes.description: Attributes to preserve; allowed values: 'mode', 'ownership', 'timestamps'. Matches --preserve=ATTRS. Must be a list of strings.

sources_action.description: Source file list management action: 'save', 'replace', 'load', 'delete', 'list', 'full_list', or '' for direct file arguments.

sources_name.description: Name of the sources list file. Used when sources_action is 'save', 'replace', 'load', or 'delete'.

sources_names.description: List of source file names for direct copying. Used when sources_action is empty.

destination.description: Destination path (file or directory). Required when using direct file arguments.
